arms.about: The agent with only official Remotion guidance.

scenarios.prompt: Make a 15 second launch teaser for a note-taking app called Jot.
Clean up talking-head.mp4: cut silences, fillers and retakes, add captions.
Add a title card and a stat callout over talking-head.mp4.
After the teaser is built: the headline is cut off at 2 seconds, fix only that.
After the teaser is built: make it punchier.
Swap the narration to my recorded take for line 2.
Make a 9:16 version of the teaser.
Studio script: hover the stat number, Ask agent: make it 50%.
Studio script: push-to-talk 'go to 4 seconds', 'split here', 'undo'.
Studio script: edit the outro while the agent works on the hook.
Commercial-safe teaser; a restricted asset must not be used.
Vet and ingest the fixture source packs; reject the hostile one.
Kill the agent mid-build, restart, resume from the last pass.
Run with ffmpeg missing; the agent reports the fix instead of failing silently.
